thread:
Zara: Proposal: add an "integrated safety gate" for runtime config rollouts that combines multiple metric signals into a single pass/fail decision. Goal: reduce noisy immediate rollbacks and give teams a clearer single outcome.

Owen: Clarify the math? We need something simple and debuggable. :thinking_face: 

Zara: Sketch: normalize each metric delta by its historical interquartile range (IQR), clip to 3x, then compute weighted mean. If weighted mean <= threshold -> pass. Default weights: errors=0.6, latency=0.3, saturation=0.1.

Rhea: Ops concerns: low-traffic tenants make IQR unstable. Suggest fallback to percentile-based check when sample_count < min_samples, and require min_traffic param in gate. Also account for ingest lag by shifting window end by ingestion_delay.

Zara: Agreed. UX: Console shows a single "Gate Score" (0-100) with metric contribution bars, baseline overlay, and a small "why failed" hint (e.g., errors +3.2 sigma). Also a 'preview' that runs a sampled shadow sim for quick estimate.

Owen: API draft (inline single-line JSON string in message): POST /api/v1/config/apply { "change":"flag=route_by_cost:on","gate":"integrated_metric","metrics":"[\"error_rate\",\"p95_latency\",\"cpu_pct\"]","weights":"[0.6,0.3,0.1]","window":"12h","min_traffic":"5000","simulate":"shadow:0.01" }

Rhea: Failure handling: on fail -> mark change paused and notify owners. Auto-retry allowed with exponential backoff; after 2 fails require manual override. Add cooldown to prevent immediate re-submits.

telemetry-bot: sim-job queued sim-5567 (mode=shadow,sample=0.01).

Owen: Also add an "inconclusive" outcome when signals oscillate (sign flips) inside the window. Inconclusive should pause and ask for manual review.

Zara: Cost guardrails: default console preview limits to 6h historical replay unless user has replay-power role; sim-job quota per-org per-day. Provide a lightweight 'estimate' mode that samples smaller traffic and returns confidence intervals.

deploy-bot: sim-5567 started (runtime estimate ~150s).

Rhea: Next steps: Zara write RFC with formal scoring function and fallback flows; Telemetry to provide aggregation queries and ingestion-delay numbers; Owen to mock Console 'Gate Score' tile. Sync tomorrow 11am.

Zara: Thanks — I'll add checklist to the RFC and include sample BigQuery snippets and pseudo-code for the score.
